bugs.title: Security: GET /v1/api-keys returns every API key in full
steps: Settings → API keys → create a key. The dialog says "You will not be able to view it again".
Call GET /v1/api-keys (or GET /v1/api-keys/<id>) with a normal login token.
bugs.expected: The list shows the key masked (e.g. only the last 4 characters); the full key is only returned once, when it is created.
bugs.actual: The list and GET by id return every key in full, so anyone who can read the list can copy any key.
tests: tests/settings/api-keys/api-keys.api.spec.ts › should not return the full key once it has been created

bugs.title: A rejected booking still creates a contact for the new patient
steps: POST /v1/clinics/appointments for a new patient with an unknown doctorId (or with startDate after endDate).
The API answers 404 "Doctor not found" (or 400 "startDate must be before endDate").
Search contacts for the patient's name.
bugs.expected: A rejected booking changes nothing: no contact is created.
bugs.actual: A contact for the patient is created anyway, so failed bookings leave stray contacts behind.
tests: tests/clinic/appointments/appointments.api.spec.ts › should not leave a contact behind when a booking is rejected

bugs.title: Booking accepts a treatment the doctor doesn't offer
steps: Have doctor A with treatment X, and doctor B with treatment Y.
POST /v1/clinics/appointments with doctor A and treatment Y.
bugs.expected: 422: the treatment is not offered by this doctor (the New appointment dialog only lists the doctor's own treatments).
bugs.actual: 201: the appointment is booked. Please confirm with product whether this should be allowed.
tests: tests/clinic/appointments/appointments.api.spec.ts › should reject a treatment the doctor doesn't offer

bugs.title: Deleted appointment stays on the calendar until the page is reloaded
steps: Clinic → Appointments: open an appointment on the calendar.
Delete appointment and confirm.
bugs.expected: The card and the day's "1 appt" count disappear straight away.
bugs.actual: The server deletes it, but the card and the count stay until the page is reloaded.
tests: tests/clinic/appointments/appointments.spec.ts › should take a deleted appointment off the calendar straight away

bugs.title: Contacts: column choices are lost after a reload
steps: Contacts → Columns: hide or show a column.
Reload the page.
bugs.expected: The list keeps the chosen columns.
bugs.actual: The default columns come back. The choice is not saved anywhere (no API call, nothing in local storage).
tests: tests/contacts/contacts-list.spec.ts › should keep the column choice after a reload

bugs.title: Blocked contacts still appear under Everyone in Contacts
steps: Block a contact.
Open Contacts → Everyone.
bugs.expected: The blocked contact appears only under More → Blocked.
bugs.actual: It is listed under Everyone as well (the list's search sends no "blocked" filter). Please confirm the intended behaviour with product.
tests: tests/contacts/contacts-row-actions.spec.ts › should hide a blocked contact from the main contact list

bugs.title: POST /v1/contacts accepts a contact without a first name
steps: POST /v1/contacts without firstName (even an empty body {}).
bugs.expected: 422 naming firstName as required, as the Create contact form does.
bugs.actual: 201: a contact with no name is created.
tests: tests/contacts/contacts.api.spec.ts › should reject a contact without a first name with 422

bugs.title: GET /v1/contacts/segment-counts always answers 400 (called on every Contacts page load)
steps: Open Contacts, or call GET /v1/contacts/segment-counts.
bugs.expected: 200 with the segment counts.
bugs.actual: 400 "Validation failed (uuid is expected)", the same answer as GET /v1/contacts/not-a-uuid: the request seems to be caught by the GET /v1/contacts/:id route.
tests: tests/contacts/contacts.api.spec.ts › GET /v1/contacts/segment-counts should answer 200

bugs.title: Opening /inbox directly shows "Something went wrong"
steps: Log in.
Go to https://beta.replyn.dev/inbox directly (e.g. from a bookmark).
bugs.expected: The inbox of the current workspace opens.
bugs.actual: "Something went wrong". Only /inbox/<workspace id>, which the sidebar links to, works.
tests: tests/inbox/saved-views/saved-views.spec.ts › should show the inbox when /inbox is opened without a workspace

bugs.title: Reports accept a date range that ends before it starts
steps: GET /v1/reports/contacts/summary with start and end swapped (end before start).
bugs.expected: 422: the range is invalid.
bugs.actual: 200 with numbers.
tests: tests/reports/reports.api.spec.ts › should reject a range that ends before it starts with 422

bugs.title: GET /v1/lifecycles fails without the optional ?contactCount= parameter
steps: GET /v1/lifecycles with no query string.
bugs.expected: 200 with the lifecycle stages; contactCount is optional.
bugs.actual: 400 "Validation failed (boolean string is expected)".
tests: tests/settings/lifecycle/lifecycle.api.spec.ts › should list the stages without asking for contact counts

bugs.title: Renaming a role fails unless its permissions are sent again
steps: Create a custom role.
PATCH /v1/workspaces/<id>/roles/<role id> with only { "name": "New name" }.
bugs.expected: 200: the role is renamed and keeps its permissions.
bugs.actual: 422, and the message lists every valid permission instead of saying `permissions` is missing.
tests: tests/settings/roles/roles.api.spec.ts › should rename a role without resending its permissions

bugs.title: Creating a webhook with an unknown event crashes with 500
steps: POST /v1/webhooks/endpoints with filterTypes: ["contact.deleted"] (not an allowed event).
bugs.expected: 422 naming the allowed events (see /v1/webhooks/event-types).
bugs.actual: 500 "Internal server error".
tests: tests/settings/webhooks/webhooks.api.spec.ts › should reject an unknown event with 422

bugs.title: Saving an empty workspace name answers 200 and silently does nothing
steps: PATCH /v1/workspaces/<id> with { "name": "" }.
bugs.expected: 422: the name is required.
bugs.actual: 200, and the old name is quietly kept, so the caller thinks it was saved.
tests: tests/settings/workspace/workspace.api.spec.ts › should reject an empty workspace name with 422

bugs.title: Wrap-up outcome result (category) is not validated
steps: Save the wrap-up (POST /v1/wrap-up) with an outcome whose category is "pending".
bugs.expected: 422: the result must be won, in_progress or lost (what the page offers).
bugs.actual: Saved as "pending"; any text is accepted.
tests: tests/settings/wrap-up/wrap-up.api.spec.ts › should reject an outcome with an unknown result with 422

bugs.title: Wrap-Up: outcomes saved without ids show "Needs attention" and can't be saved
steps: Save the wrap-up through the API with an outcome and step that have no `id` (the API accepts this).
Open Settings → Wrap-Up, change that outcome and press Save changes.
bugs.expected: The change is saved (or the API refuses outcomes without ids in the first place).
bugs.actual: The outcome is marked "Needs attention" with no reason shown, and nothing is saved.
tests: tests/settings/wrap-up/wrap-up.spec.ts › should save an edit to an outcome that was created through the API without ids

bugs.title: Empty required fields are reported as "too long" (4 endpoints)
steps: POST an empty body {} to /v1/custom-views, /v1/contact-fields and /v1/outcome-reasons.
PUT an empty list [] to /v1/workspaces/<id>/slas.
bugs.expected: 422 saying the field is required, e.g. "name should not be empty", "label should not be empty", "clocks should not be empty".
bugs.actual: 422 with a message describing the opposite problem: "name must be shorter than or equal to 60 characters" (views), "label must be shorter than or equal to 255 characters" (contact fields), "... 80 characters" (outcome reasons), "clocks must contain no more than 6 elements" (SLAs).
tests: tests/inbox/saved-views/saved-views.api.spec.ts › should reject an empty view with 422 saying the name and icon are required
tests/settings/contact-fields/contact-fields.api.spec.ts › should reject an empty field with 422 naming the label and type
tests/settings/outcome-reasons/outcome-reasons.api.spec.ts › should reject an empty reason with 422 naming the label and answers
tests/settings/sla/sla.api.spec.ts › should reject an empty list of clocks with a clear 422

bugs.title: Security: an Agent can update the workspace (PATCH /v1/workspaces/<id> answers 200)
steps: Log in as a workspace member with the built-in Agent role (no workspace settings permission).
Call PATCH /v1/workspaces/<workspace id> with the Agent's login token.
bugs.expected: 403 "Insufficient permissions", like every other settings endpoint (SLAs, assignment rules, organization, roles) answers an Agent.
bugs.actual: 200 with the workspace record: the endpoint has no permission check, so an Agent can likely rename the workspace or change its hours and AI settings (only an empty body was sent, so nothing was changed).
tests: tests/permissions/agent-access.api.spec.ts › should not let an Agent change the workspace settings

bugs.title: A workflow with validation errors can be switched on with PATCH
steps: Create a workflow that has only a trigger (no action step). The API lists "Workflow must have at least one action step" in validationErrors.
POST /v1/workflows/<id>/activate (what the Live switch sends): 400 "Workflow validation failed", as expected.
PATCH /v1/workflows/<id> with { "isActive": true }.
bugs.expected: PATCH refuses to activate it too (400 "Workflow validation failed"), so a broken workflow can never run.
bugs.actual: 200, and the workflow is active while validationErrors still lists the problem. Any API client (or a custom script) can switch on a workflow the page refuses to activate.
tests: tests/workflows/workflows.api.spec.ts › should not let PATCH activate a workflow that has validation errors

bugs.title: GET /v1/channels says there are 12 channels but returns none
steps: In a workspace without channels ("Workspace for reports testing"), call GET /v1/channels (with or without ?limit=100&page=1).
bugs.expected: meta.count matches the channels returned (0 here), or the channels are returned.
bugs.actual: result is [] while meta.count is 12 and nextPage is null. The count seems to include channels of other workspaces in the organization, so anything that pages or counts with it is wrong.
tests: tests/broadcasts/broadcasts.api.spec.ts › should report the same channel count as the channels it returns

bugs.title: A segment can be saved with a name of only spaces
steps: POST /v1/segments with the name "   ".
bugs.expected: 422, like an empty name.
bugs.actual: 201: the segment is saved with a blank name and an empty slug.
tests: tests/contacts/contacts-segments.api.spec.ts › should reject a name of only spaces with 422

bugs.title: A segment can be saved with a filter rule that does not exist
steps: POST /v1/segments with a rule whose field or operator does not exist, e.g. {"field":"nope","operator":"contains","value":"x"}.
bugs.expected: 422 naming the bad rule.
bugs.actual: 201: the rule is stored as sent.
tests: tests/contacts/contacts-segments.api.spec.ts › should reject a rule with an unknown field with 422
tests/contacts/contacts-segments.api.spec.ts › should reject a rule with an unknown operator with 422

bugs.title: GET /v1/segments/<malformed id> answers 500
steps: GET /v1/segments/not-a-uuid.
bugs.expected: 400 "Validation failed (uuid is expected)", as /v1/contacts answers.
bugs.actual: 500 "Internal server error".
tests: tests/contacts/contacts-segments.api.spec.ts › should answer 400 for a malformed id

bugs.title: Moving a contact to a stage that does not exist answers 500
steps: PATCH /v1/contacts/<id> with a lifecycleId that no stage has, or one that is not a UUID.
bugs.expected: A 4xx that names the lifecycleId.
bugs.actual: 500 "Internal server error".
tests: tests/contacts/contacts-actions.api.spec.ts › should reject a stage id no stage has
tests/contacts/contacts-actions.api.spec.ts › should reject a stage id that is not a UUID

bugs.title: An empty note can be saved on a contact
steps: POST /v1/contacts/<id>/activity with type "note" and empty text, or with no payload.
bugs.actual: 201: a blank note is added to the contact's timeline.
tests: tests/contacts/contacts-actions.api.spec.ts › should reject a note with empty text
tests/contacts/contacts-actions.api.spec.ts › should reject a note without a payload

bugs.title: Resolving a conversation accepts a closing note category that does not exist
steps: PATCH /v1/contacts/<id> with status "closed" and a closingNote whose topicId no closing note has.
bugs.expected: A 4xx that names the topicId.
bugs.actual: 200: the conversation closes, and the timeline keeps only the summary: the category is silently dropped.
tests: tests/contacts/contacts-actions.api.spec.ts › should reject a closing note category that does not exist
